statement: A synthetic artifact used to diagnose a measured miss must be committed and pinned before its contents support an inventory disposition. A coverage-node specimen existed only in a shared working tree, so its command-only shape could not be reproduced from origin/main and a later diagnosis silently relied on local state. Require a public derivation record for every known miss specimen; unresolved or unversioned evidence remains an explicit state rather than becoming a detector finding or a closure.

movesWhen.reason: Move after the derivation-record guard and committed canonical specimen policy are merged, with a verified product commit selected as the anchor.
